findings.finding: Completed checkpoint reuse is missing from the request planner lookup.
findings.source: hw/hw_proof_queue.cpp: hw_proof_process_req scans queued_proofs for a reusable checkpoint; dispatch removes a checkpoint from queued_proofs.
findings.evidence: 240 identical checkpoint segments were computed again after a prior publication within the same board/native job. Different new checkpoint boundaries also reconstruct previously covered prefixes; the exact-segment count is a lower bound on repeated range coverage.
findings.next_step: Test bounded completed-checkpoint reuse, preserving request identity, proof validity, recovery invalidation, cancellation and the 61-checkpoint wire bound. Measure whether long chains need a coarser reusable checkpoint spine to avoid growing final tails.
